request: 配置信号超时时间 5 秒，启用死区检测
config:
```yaml
general:
  dev_error_detect: true
  version_info_api: true
ComSignal:
  - signal_id: 0
    timeout: 5000
    dead_zone_enabled: true
    dead_zone_value: 0.1
```

request: 启用网关功能，配置 10 个 PDU
config:
```yaml
general:
  dev_error_detect: true
  gateway_enabled: true
  max_pdus: 10
ComPdu:
  - pdu_id: 0
    direction: TX
    length: 64
  - pdu_id: 1
    direction: RX
    length: 64
```
